text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, thanks for picking me up!
choice_data_list: Did you have a good time?
Were you able to enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, thanks for picking me up!
choice_data_list: Did you have a good time?
Were you able to enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's the Derby, after all, there's no 
way it wouldn't be fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Running through the final stretch parted 
by the roaring cheers...! Forget once in a 
lifetime, I want to run it again and 
again!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I felt so fulfilled during that run! I'm 
sure everyone felt my charm loud and 
clear♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, that wraps up the 2nd leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, so naturally, the 
next one is the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, aiming for the third leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown— the Kikuka Sho—is by 
no means a bad choice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the greatest stage to showcase 
Maruzensky's running awaits at the end of 
the year...!
choice_data_list: Our goal is the Arima Kinen!
Our goal is the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So you want me to show off my running on a 
major, high-profile stage with the Senior 
Class in the mix, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that sounds like a blast! Let's take 
on the challenge: the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting their sights on the Arima Kinen as 
the next goal, the curtain fell on the 
Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text: That was one hell of a race.

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so much so that it makes me want to 
run...
